benchmark.definition: Confirmed + strict long trend + next adjusted Open + Support −5% Stop + 2R TP

trend.items: SPY and QQQ: Close>50DMA, Close>200DMA, 50DMA>200DMA, positive 20D 200DMA slope; 5 points each

momentum.items: Each index: daily MACD direction 4, histogram direction 2, recent/pre-cross 2, prior completed-week MACD 4, weekly histogram 3

breadth.items: Equal-weight continuous average of above50, above200, bullish trend, inverse bearish trend

answers.direction_consistency: See by_period_regime; no parameter was selected or optimized.

limitations: Research cache current date may lag the production daily pipeline; the page displays its own as-of date.
Breadth uses the deterministic V1 survivorship-aware universe with partial delisted coverage, not the complete historical US market.
Regime thresholds and weights are fixed ex ante and were not fitted to returns.
Signals overlap; drawdown remains the V2 non-overlapping cohort diagnostic.
